...RED FLAG WARNING IS CANCELLED...

The temperature has dropped, the relative humidity has increased
above critical levels, and the strong winds have decreased. Hence,
the Red Flag Warning has been cancelled. Strong northerly wind will
occur behind a strong cold front this evening into tonight, but
relative humidity will continue to increase and mitigate any fire
weather threat.
